coverage_note: Only the two replacement gallery photos are registered here. They were sourced on 2026-11-03 when the oceans family fix removed two wrong-sea gallery photos (NASA satellite views of Egypt and the eastern Mediterranean, captioned as North Sea views) from src/lib/oceans.ts. Licence, author and dimensions were verified via the Wikimedia Commons API (imageinfo extmetadata) for each exact file. The width/height/sha1 below describe the Commons originals; the site serves 1280px WebP derivatives stored in public/images/oceans/. The North Sea hero (Cromer, by ruth e, CC BY-SA 2.0) predates this record and lives in the data file only.
